<|det|>header [42, 34, 187, 48]<|/det|>MEETING NOTES
<|det|>text [42, 69, 306, 86]<|/det|>Date: September 27, 2026
<|det|>text [41, 105, 775, 177]<|/det|>The research team reviewed the new document recognition system. Every result must include the original input and a clear transcript. We measure complete page latency, memory use, and character errors. Faster processing is useful only when the output remains accurate.
<|det|>title [42, 195, 281, 210]<|/det|>Actions for next week:
<|det|>text [42, 212, 464, 228]<|/det|>1. Check English and Chinese documents.
<|det|>text [42, 230, 657, 246]<|/det|>2. Test tables, small print, and unusual page dimensions.
<|det|>text [42, 248, 775, 264]<|/det|>3. Save failures and incomplete outputs with the successful results.
<|det|>text [42, 266, 571, 282]<|/det|>4. Compare identical inputs on the same computer.
<|det|>text [42, 302, 391, 318]<|/det|>Approved by: Research Operations

<|det|>title [43, 36, 252, 57]<|/det|>文档识别测试报告
<|det|>text [45, 84, 402, 105]<|/det|>日期：二零二六年九月二十七日
<|det|>text [42, 131, 491, 152]<|/det|>本报告用于检查中文文档识别的正确性。
<|det|>text [45, 155, 542, 175]<|/det|>每次测试都应保存原始图片和完整识别结果。
<|det|>text [45, 178, 617, 199]<|/det|>性能指标包括处理时间、内存使用量和字符错误率。
<|det|>text [45, 201, 567, 223]<|/det|>提高运行速度的同时，必须保持文字识别准确。
<|det|>text [42, 249, 167, 269]<|/det|>测试要求：
<|det|>text [42, 272, 440, 293]<|/det|>第一，检查标题和正文的阅读顺序。
<|det|>text [45, 296, 490, 316]<|/det|>第二，检查数字、标点符号和表格内容。
<|det|>text [45, 319, 465, 340]<|/det|>第三，不得忽略失败或未完成的测试。
<|det|>text [45, 343, 440, 364]<|/det|>第四，在相同设备上比较相同输入。
<|det|>text [43, 390, 251, 412]<|/det|>负责人：研究团队
